ywzj_vehicle.dump_truck.description: A dump truck carries loose materials such as sand, gravel and soil in a tipping cargo bed. Most designs use hydraulic equipment to raise the bed and unload by gravity. Dump trucks are widely used in construction, road works and mining.
ywzj_vehicle.ztl11.description: The ZTL-11 is a Chinese eight-wheeled amphibious assault vehicle in the Type 08 armored vehicle family, armed primarily with a 105 mm rifled gun. It provides direct fire support for wheeled mechanized units and can engage lightly armored vehicles and fortifications, combining road mobility with off-road capability.
ywzj_vehicle.ztz99a.description: The ZTZ-99A is an improved variant of China's Type 99 main battle tank. It uses a tracked chassis and a 125 mm smoothbore gun with an autoloader. Compared with earlier Type 99 tanks, it incorporates improvements to fire control, sights, propulsion and protection, and serves in Chinese Army heavy combined-arms formations.
ywzj_vehicle.z10.description: The Z-10 is a Chinese twin-engine attack helicopter manufactured by Changhe Aircraft Industries, with a tandem cockpit for two crew members. Its main roles include anti-armor operations and ground fire support. It can carry a cannon, rockets and anti-tank missiles, with a secondary air-to-air capability.
ywzj_vehicle.motorcycle.description: A motorcycle is a lightweight motor vehicle steered by its rider using handlebars. Compact two-wheeled designs are commonly used for commuting, touring and recreation, while specialized versions serve off-road riding or racing. Passenger and cargo capacity is generally more limited than that of a car.
ywzj_vehicle.hiace.description: The Toyota HiAce is a light commercial vehicle series introduced by Toyota in 1967. Its generations include panel vans, minibuses and various specialized vehicles. It is primarily used for passenger and cargo transport, with seating layouts, engines and dimensions varying by generation and market.
ywzj_vehicle.quadcopter.description: A quadcopter drone uses four rotors to generate lift and controls its attitude and movement by varying their speeds. Small quadcopters can typically take off vertically and hover. Common uses include aerial photography, inspection, surveying and observation; endurance and payload depend on the design.
ywzj_vehicle.m1a2.description: The M1A2 is an upgraded variant of the American M1 Abrams main battle tank. It is armed with a 120 mm M256 smoothbore gun and uses a gas turbine engine and composite armor. The M1A2 improves sights, fire control and digital coordination over earlier variants, with further upgrades introduced through successive System Enhancement Packages.
ywzj_vehicle.cssa5.description: The CS/SA5 is a Chinese wheeled short-range air-defense system developed for export. It combines a rotary cannon, surface-to-air missiles and detection equipment on an eight-wheeled chassis, primarily to engage low-flying aircraft and other aerial targets. Publicly displayed versions differ in chassis and armament configuration.
ywzj_vehicle.ah64d.description: The AH-64D Apache Longbow is an upgraded version of the American AH-64 attack helicopter, with twin engines, tandem seating and improved avionics and target acquisition systems. It can be fitted with a mast-mounted Longbow fire-control radar. Typical armament includes a 30 mm chain gun, Hellfire missiles and 70 mm rockets for anti-armor and ground-support missions.
ywzj_vehicle.lav_ad.description: The LAV-AD is a short-range air-defense variant of the eight-wheeled LAV family, formerly used by the U.S. Marine Corps. Its turret combines a 25 mm GAU-12 five-barrel rotary cannon with Stinger surface-to-air missiles to protect mobile units against low-altitude threats. It retains the family's wheeled mobility and amphibious capability.
ywzj_vehicle.lav150.description: The LAV-150, also known as the V-150, belongs to the American Cadillac Gage Commando family of four-wheeled armored vehicles. The platform supports machine guns, autocannons or larger guns, as well as personnel-carrier configurations. Exported to numerous countries, it has served in patrol, security and fire-support roles.
ywzj_vehicle.bgm_71_tow.description: The BGM-71 TOW is an American anti-tank missile system named for its original tube-launched, optically tracked, wire-guided design. It uses semi-automatic command-to-line-of-sight guidance, requiring the operator to keep the sight on the target during flight. The family can use ground tripods or various vehicle platforms, with later versions improving warheads and guidance links.
ywzj_vehicle.ah_6.description: The AH-6 Little Bird is a light attack helicopter derived from the OH-6 and MD 500 series, sharing its family with the MH-6 personnel-transport variant. Its compact airframe suits special-operations support. Depending on the version and mission, it can carry machine guns, rockets or missiles for light attack and escort duties.
ywzj_vehicle.j10c.description: The J-10C is an upgraded single-engine multirole fighter in the J-10 family, developed and produced by China's Chengdu Aircraft Corporation. It uses a canard-delta layout and features an active electronically scanned array radar and improved avionics. Its roles include interception, air superiority, and attacks on ground and maritime targets.
ywzj_vehicle.rafale.description: The Rafale is a French twin-engine, canard-delta multirole fighter developed by Dassault Aviation. Its main versions include single-seat and two-seat land-based aircraft and a carrier-based variant. It performs air-superiority, ground-attack, reconnaissance and anti-ship missions for France and several export customers, with equipment varying by variant and upgrade standard.
ywzj_vehicle.atv_coyoto.description: The Coyote is a light armed off-road vehicle with an open body and a machine-gun station. It can support short-range movement, patrols and mobile fire support. Its compact layout emphasizes mobility, with limited crew protection and transport space.
ywzj_vehicle.atv_mrzr4.description: The MRZR-4 is a four-seat light all-terrain vehicle in the American Polaris MRZR family, derived from a side-by-side off-road platform. Its open, unarmored design supports personnel and supply transport for small units. Engines and payload configurations vary across the MRZR family.
ywzj_vehicle.htf5980.description: The HTF5980 is a Chinese eight-axle, sixteen-wheel heavy special-purpose chassis developed by Taian Special Vehicle Company. It uses multi-axle steering for road-mobile transport of large missiles. Its transporter-erector-launcher configuration is associated with the DF-41 intercontinental ballistic missile and combines transport, erection and launch-platform functions.
ywzj_vehicle.j36.description: J-36 is a commonly used external designation for a new aircraft undergoing flight testing by Chengdu Aircraft Corporation, seen in public imagery in December 2024. Observed features include a tailless layout and three engines. Its official designation, intended roles and performance have not been fully disclosed, so claims about its generation and combat capabilities remain uncertain.
ywzj_vehicle.assault_boat.description: An assault boat is a small craft used to transport personnel and equipment, commonly for river crossings, near-shore landings and movement on inland waters. Depending on its design, it may be paddled or powered by an outboard motor. Capacity, protection and seaworthiness vary by model.
